newsitem.title: USA: La. sweet crudes weaken late, spark US cash trades.
newsitem.headline: La. sweet crudes weaken late, spark US cash trades.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes ended the session mixed, finding late selling pressure for Louisiana sweet grades, while sour barrels moved at firmer levels.
Outright crude prices finished stronger on short covering plays in the futures markets ahead of the Thursday expiration of the March NYMEX contract.
March West Texas Intermediate/Cushing closed out around 20 cents higher at $22.70-80 a barrel.
Grade business featured active plays for Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James, where parcels moved at fluctuating prices all session, ending up a shade under the closing ranges Tuesday.
